notes.title: Major Update — Patch Notes v0.6.0
notes.notes:
Dear OverRiders, Greetings!

Thank you for your unwavering passion and feedback! After intensive development, OverRider Version 0.6.0 is now officially live! 

This update focuses on improving the early-game experience and in-run build depth, along with a wide range of new content and system overhauls. Here's what's new:


[hr][/hr]

Core Rework: 「Override-Cores」 & 「Enhancement-Chips」


Nearly all \[Override-Cores] and \[Enhancement-Chips] have been redesigned, featuring updated effects and improved synergy.

30+ new \[Override-Cores] have been added, offering greater build diversity.

30+ new \[Enhancement-Chips], including a powerful new category: \[Pristine Chips], which can drastically shape your run strategy.

The full build pool now includes over 140 tactical components, including \[Combat-Exensions] — providing greater freedom and strategic possibilities!


[hr][/hr]

Difficulty & Encounter Adjustments


New Difficulty: Hard Mode — a fresh challenge for experienced players.

The previous “Elite Zones” have been replaced with new “Trial Zones”, including: 

Trial: Override 

Trial: Block

Trial: Deflect 

Trial: Prime

Standalone Shop Zones have been removed. Shops are now fully integrated into the pre-Boss areas for a smoother game flow.
 [hr][/hr]

Reward System & \[Neural Network] Upgrades


Reward distribution has been overhauled with a weighted system, ensuring rewards are more aligned with your current build path.

New: Reward Refresh Mechanic — unlockable via the \[Neural Network] interface, giving players more control over in-run options.

Several \[Neural Network] modules have been adjusted for better balance and synergy.


[hr][/hr]

Boss Overhaul


New Boss: \[Miss Crimson] now replaces the old \[Swam Squad] as a major encounter.

Former \[Wasps] are now elite enemies, while \[Hornets] appear as common units in later stages.

Updated Boss Order:
[olist]
Yokozuna

Roxane

Miss Crimson

Ritsuko Nitta


[/olist][hr][/hr]Override Core Activation


All equipped Override Cores now fully activate upon ONE triggering, removing the need for multiple Override uses to power them up.


Skill Module Adjustments


The 「Skill Module」 Unlocking system has been removed. All character skills are now available from the start of a run.

「Trait Upgrades」 are now character-specific upgrades, and may appear in reward chests at the end of each area.

「Evolution Modules」 remain unchanged in both mechanics and availability.


[hr][/hr]

Character Enhancement System Returns


The Attribute Enhancement System is back!
You can now upgrade special stats to permanently boost your combat capabilities across runs.


[hr][/hr]

Other Improvements


Enemies now have a chance to drop Data-Coins upon defeat.

Talent: “Coin Drop Rate” has been adjusted to increase additional drop chance.

Drone AI Behavior has been improved — drones now auto-target and attack enemies without manual input.

The original “→ + Skill” input has been replaced with a Secondary Skill Button:
▸ Default Key: K (Keyboard), RB (Xbox Controller)

New \[Pristine Chips]: Hyper Reassembly — allows players to quickly switch between their original body and acquired body using the secondary skill key. (Requires talent ELBIS mkII to unlock)


[hr][/hr]

Thank You!


Once again, thank you to all our players for being part of this journey! Every bit of feedback and every play session continues to inspire us to make OverRider the best game it can be.

We welcome your thoughts and impressions of the v0.6.0 update — feel free to join the discussion in the Steam Community or leave a comment!



— The OverRider Dev Team

notes.title: Major Update — Patch Notes v0.5.0
notes.notes:
Dear OverRiders,

Thank you for your unwavering passion and feedback! After intensive development, OverRider Version 0.5.0 is now officially live! This update focuses on core system optimizations and new content additions, aiming to elevate your gameplay experience and immersion. Here are the full details:


🔧 I. Core Systems: Base Status Revamp


Attribute System Overhaul: We've completely redesigned the base attributes, dividing them into 8 distinct categories, with clearer UI feedback for progression. Status growth will directly impact your combat style and strategic depth.

New Attribute System:

Attack: Directly increases your final damage output.

HP: Raises your maximum HP. (Note: Upgrading this does not restore current HP).

Tech(formerly "Hack Rate"): Significantly boosts the effects of the three core systems: Chips, Extensions, and Cores.

Max Stamina: Determines the maximum number of dodges you can perform in quick succession.

Core (Active) Duration: Extends the active duration of the \[OverRider-Core].

E.P. Gain: Increases the final amount of ELPIS earned in combat.

Extension Charge Rate: Accelerates the charge speed of \[combat Extensions].

Override Threshold: Lowers the HP threshold required to \[Override] targets, making it easier to control the battlefield.

Neural Network (Talent) System Adaptation: Related Nods have been optimized and adjusted to match the new attribute system. Rest assured, previously unlocked Nods do not need to be re-unlocked.


⭐ II. Exploration Rewards: Zone Supply Crates


Completing each minor zone now guarantees a drop of 1-Star Supply Crate!

Crate Contents: Contains essential and useful supplies:

Status Upgrades

First Aid Kits

Crystals

Digital Coins


🧠 III. Narrative Upgrade: Memory Anchor


Unlock Forgotten Memories: A new \[Memory Anchor] interaction is now available in the Clinic. Unlock and use them to join Mayoi in recovering her lost memory fragments, gradually unveiling deeper lore and the game's world.

More Freedom in Story Experience:

Mandatory story segments during the main questline have been reduced to approximately 30% of the total narrative.

Most mandatory cutscenes can be skipped, and skipping will not prevent you from completing main quests.

Review Anytime: For skipped story content, we've added a convenient \[Story Playback] feature. You can revisit any missed plot points anytime in the Clinic, ensuring you never miss crucial information.


🏥 IV. Clinic Expansion: New Scene - Chrysalis Hall


We've expanded the Clinic with a new core functional area: the Chrysalis Hall.

Functional Role: The Chrysalis Hall will serve as your primary preparation zone before missions, handling core functions like equipment adjustment and status management.

Future Plans: This is just the beginning! In future updates, we plan to integrate more mission preparation and character progression features into the Chrysalis Hall. Stay tuned!


[hr][/hr]


Once again, our heartfelt thanks to all OverRiders for your support! 🎮 Your valuable feedback and every moment spent in our world are the driving force behind our continuous efforts to refine and improve the game.

We welcome you to share your thoughts and suggestions about Version 0.5.0 in the Steam Community or comments section below. We are listening and committed to bringing you an even more thrilling world of OverRider!

Let's embark on the OverRider journey together!



— The OverRider Development Team

notes.title: Minor Update—Patch Notes v0.4.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We’ve rolled out a minor update for [Overrider]—thank you all for your patience and invaluable feedback. This patch includes:

🔥 Critical Update—Skill Module Adjustments

– The “↑ + Skill” module’s upgrade option has been removed and reverted to its original, off-the-bat basic skill.
– This change meant to restores the character’s original combat fluidity and prevents the sluggish feel caused by over-nerfing.

🐱 Boss “Roxanne (Catgirl)” Optimizations

Counterattack State Indicators

– Eyes Open: Enters an alert state—any form of damage will immediately trigger a counterattack.
– Eyes Closed: Enters a non-alert state—short bursts of damage won’t trigger a counterattack, but if she keeps taking hits, she will forcibly flee after a while.

📝 Other Adjustments

– Refined story dialogue details: added missing Japanese text and provided localized translations.
– Fixed several minor bugs and improved overall stability.

Apology & Outlook

We over-nerfed character performance in our recent “Build System” adjustments, which led to a subpar combat feel. We sincerely apologize for this misstep. Our goal was to make room for more Build elements but we overlooked how essential the core combat experience is. Thanks to your prompt feedback, we’ve rolled back and optimized the key changes in this update.

We’ll keep monitoring the data and your suggestions—our unwavering aim is to make the game more fun and smoother!

Thank you again for your support and companionship. Enjoy the game!

— The [Overrider] Dev Team

notes.title: Major Update — Patch Notes v0.4.0
notes.notes:
Dear [Overrider] Players!

After a month of intensive development, we’re thrilled to officially launch Version 0.4.0! This update focuses on two core pillars: overhauling combat mechanics and refining progression systems. Let’s dive into the details!

🔧 1. Complete Overhaul of Character Skill System

We’ve completely redesigned the character progression system:
— Removed Clinic character Rank-ups; All progression now happens in Hunt runs.
— Skill power now depends on your in-combat choices, not preset builds!

New Progression Structure:

🔹 Skill Modules (Shared by all characters, unlocked permanently):

— Skill Mod [ ↑ + Skill ]
— Skill Mod [ → + Skill ]
— Skill Mod [Normal+Traits]
— Skill Mod [ Ultimate ]
— Skill Mod [Block+EmEv]

🔸 Evolution Modules (Character-specific):

— Unique upgrades for each character.
— Unlock powerful traits exclusive to their playstyle during matches.

🧩 2. Core System Optimization

To enhance build clarity and strategy, we’ve revamped the Core-Extension-Chip mechanics:

✅ Combat Extension:

— No longer tied to Cores. Change the definition From [Override-Extension] to [Combat-Extension]
— Charge energy by attacking enemies → Trigger effects at full charge.

✅ Tiered Core System (Lv1/Lv2/Lv3):

— Activate sequentially: Lv1 → Lv2 → Lv3.
— Higher tiers stack lower-tier effects.
— Still upgraded via "Override" mechanics.

✅ Chips:

— Retains original design with balance adjustments.

⚔️ 3. Major Combat & System Updates

🌟 Boss Battles Reworked:

— Nearly all bosses revamped with tighter pacing, richer mechanics, and higher stakes.
— Earn exclusive boss-themed skins for flawless (no-damage) clears!

🌟 Talent System Overhaul:

— Entire talent trees redesigned for clearer synergies and freedom.
— Drone-related talents removed → replaced with fresh options.

🌟 Drone System Removed:

— Integrated into the Core System.

🌟 New Battle Scenes:

— Added diverse environments for enhanced immersion.

🛠️ 4. Adjustments & Improvements

— Later-stage enemy HP slightly increased.
— Danger area enemies now scale with stage level.
— Chip base stats significantly buffed.
— Pre-boss point replaced with Supply Stations (purchase combat items).
— Shield Mechanics:
—— Shields no longer vanish after [Override-Core] deactivated.
—— Max shield capacity = 100% of Max HP.

🐞 5. Bug Fixes

— Fixed Bunny’s skill bullets occasionally failing to fire.
— Fixed damage taken after bullet deflection.
— Resolved move list display glitches.
— Fixed reward pickup positioning and floating object issues.
— Optimized save/load logic for stability.

Thank you for your unwavering support!
Every piece of feedback and every hour you spend in the game fuels our ongoing development. Share your thoughts on Version 0.4.0 in the comments – we’re listening!

🛠️ Let’s make OverRider better together!

— The Dev Team

We're now entering the final polishing phase — and as of today, the Beta test branch is officially open!
If you're eager to get an early look at what’s coming, you can now switch to the Beta branch and be among the first to try the new update!

🔍 What’s New in the 0.4.0 Beta
This update focuses on clarifying and streamlining combat mechanics while significantly improving in-run build progression.

Here’s a quick breakdown of the major changes:
🎯 1. Reworked Skill System
The old “Character Rank-up” system has been fully removed.
Skills are now unlocked during runs by collecting rewards — creating a more dynamic and engaging progression system.

🔹 Skill Mod (shared across all characters)
—↑ + Skill
—→ + skill
—Basic Attack Enhancer + Trait
—Ultimate Skill
—Block + Emergency Evade

—Unlocked separately during runs

—Different cores now exist at Lv1 / Lv2 / Lv3

notes.title: Version 0.4 Update Preview: Directional Discussion
notes.notes:
Hello Overriders, and thank you all for your continued support!

Following the release of v0.3.0, we've been closely reviewing your feedback and assessing the current state of the game. Based on what we've gathered, our upcoming late May update will focus on the following key areas:

🔧 1. Clarifying the Overrider System Rules
We've noticed that many players are having trouble understanding the relationship between [Cores], [Extensions], and [Chips]. While we believe the system is a critical part of gameplay—and very rewarding once mastered—we admit we haven’t explained it clearly enough.
Here’s what we’re doing:
🧩 Revamping system explanations to make them more intuitive
📘 Adding a comprehensive tutorial and onboarding flow
🖼️ Improving the UI/UX to visually represent core mechanics
Our goal is to make sure even new players can jump in and enjoy the thrill of crafting their builds.

🤖 2. Drone System Rework
The current drone system is being overhauled to simplify mechanics and bring it closer to the core Overrider loop.
Here’s the plan:
❌ The existing drone system will be removed
🧠 Drones will become a new Core type, fully integrated with the Overrider system
⚔️ Drones will no longer be tied to skills, but instead will participate directly in combat in a more intuitive way
This change is aimed at unifying all build-related mechanics into one coherent system.

📖 3. Story Progression Will Continue
The story will continue to unfold with each update. New narrative content will be added gradually as we move forward. We appreciate your patience and curiosity—there’s a lot more to uncover.
🧪 [Bonus] Current Overrider Core System: Quick Overview
For those who are still unsure how the Overrider system works, here’s a brief recap of the current rules:
🔹 Activating Overrider on any character triggers a Level 1 Core
🔹 Re-activating during its duration increases the level, up to Level 3
🔹 Each Core level trigers additional Extension Slots:
Level 1 → Slot I
Level 2 → Slots I + II
Level 3 → Slots I + II + III
⏳ When the timer ends, the Core resets to Level 0
🧬 Some Chips modify this behavior to help you reach higher Core levels faster
This system is at the heart of build customization—and we’re determined to make it as fun and understandable as possible.

💬 As always, thank you for your feedback and support. Your insights are shaping the future of the game, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.
Stay tuned for more updates!

— The Dev Team

notes.title: Patch Notes – Version 0.3.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes – Version 0.3.2
1. Terminology Updates
--We’ve streamlined and standardized in-game terminology for clarity:
--Implant-Triger → Override-Extension(or just Extension)
--Implant-Bonus → Override-Core (or just Core)
--Implant-Override → Override-Chip (or just Chip)
--Implant-Offensive → Extension: Offensive
--Implant-Supportive → Extension: Support
--Implant-Special → Extension: Special 

2. System Changes
--[Override-Chips] can now drop in regular zones.
--HARD area now reward [Override-Chip] Upgrade; instead of [Override-Chips] .
--FATAL area now guarantee a [Craft Master] as reward.
--Shops are now treated as full-fledged area, not just rewards.
--FATAL area now consist of a single boss battle—clear it and you're done.
--First-aid Kit can now be purchased multiple times. (Data cost doubles with each use.)
--area structure reworked: Every stage will now include at least one Shop and one --FATAL area as guaranteed options.

3. Balance Tweaks
--Base duration of Override-Cores increased: 20s → 30s
--Cost to unlock Shops in Neural Network changed: 3 Rare Crystals → 20 Common Crystals
--All Offensive Extensions now deal double base damage.
--Extensions: [Healing] (Lv.1): Healing increased from 30 → 100. Future upgrades scale from this.
--Extensions: [Shield Generator] (Lv.1): Shield increased from 100 → 150.
--Extensions: [Hologram Generator] : Illusions last twice as long.
--Core: [Lightning Charge]: SP regen rate doubled.
--Core: [Stamina Pack]: Stamina regen doubled.
--Core: [Power Amplifier]: Damage bonus increased by 50%.
--Core: [Shield Fortification]: Shield value increased by 33%.
--Core: [Organic Drain]: Life-steal effect increased by 300%.
--Core: [Reflection Acceleration]: Reflected projectile damage increased by 200%.
--Chip: [Overload Link]: Nerfed — it can now only trigger already active Modules.

4. Difficulty Adjustments
--Rebalanced enemy behavior—significantly reduced overly aggressive attack patterns, and greatly lowering combat difficulty for a smoother combat flow.

5. Localization & Bug Fixes
--Finished missing Japanese localization content.
--Fixed a bug that prevented certain augments from being previewed in the Augment Viewer.
--Fixed a game freeze issue caused by store-related nerual-network talents.
--Fixed an issue where [Override-Chip] upgrades were not working properly in elite zones.
--Fixed a bug where extra Overload Points were not displayed.
--Fixed an issue where elite Cyberbodies were replaced by regular ones after loading an interrupted save.
--Optimized the display of health regeneration values.

notes.title: Version 0.3.0 Major Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, Overriders!
We're thrilled to announce that Version 0.3.0 is now live! After countless hours of hard work, extensive beta testing, and the invaluable support from our community, this update is set to transform your gameplay experience. Read on for the details behind every exciting change.

1. Major Updates
1.1 New Character: Bunny
– Say hello to Bunny! This new recruit specializes in long-range attacks, adding fresh dynamics to your combat strategies. 

1.2 Revamped Prologue
--We've completely reimagined the prologue, removing punishing boss fights and elite enemies that were less friendly for newcomers. Now, new players can enjoy a smoother, more welcoming introduction to the game.

1.3 Recrafted Storyline
– Our narrative has been tightened and streamlined. The revised story now focuses on suspense and unexpected twists, delivering an experience that keeps you on the edge of your seat.

1.4 Enhanced Level Progression
– Forget the old "hunt location" method. We're returning to a traditional Rogue-Lite format with interconnected stages that form a cohesive adventure. Every run is designed to be more engaging and unpredictable.

1.5 Redesigned Route and Reward System
– Our new route selection system offers more strategic, varied rewards that truly reflect the Rogue-Lite spirit. Your choices now carry more weight and promise greater payoffs.

1.6 Upgraded Player Progression
– We’ve reworked the player growth system with major improvements:
– Outdated mechanics have been replaced with a unified, neural-network-driven Talent System.
– The Character Rank-Up system remains intact, providing diverse pathways to power up your character.

1.7 Streamlined Gameplay Features
– To simplify your experience:
– We’ve completely removed the surgical features.
– The old workshop has been retired, paving the way for mini-games to merge with the upcoming Memory Fragments system.

1.8 Overhauled Hacker Implants
– Our implant system gets a major refresh:
– The core mechanics for Active and Buff-type implants remain.
– Basic implants are gone—replaced by the new Override-type implants, which you can now equip in multiples. Expect bosses to drop even more potent versions, boosting your build options.

1.9 Simplified Material System
– All crafting materials have been consolidated into just two types, making resource management simpler and more intuitive.

1.10 Revised Difficulty System
– We’re bringing balance to challenges and rewards:
– Route-specific rewards and a revamped difficulty mechanism ensure fair yet thrilling gameplay.
– The old boss difficulty selector has been removed (no hard-mode bosses in this release). Future updates will refine the difficulty and boost replay value even further.

2 Balance Tweaks
2.1 Character Level-Up Improvements
– We've fine-tuned the level-up process for Mayoi, enhancing the overall feel and responsiveness of your upgrades.

2.2 Clearer Enemy Attack Cues
– Most enemies now display more pronounced wind-up animations before launching their attacks. This gives you extra time to plan your defense and stay one step ahead.

2.3 Optimized Ninja Mechanics
– Adjustments have been made for ourKunoichi:
– Shurikens now travel in a straight line on the same horizontal axis, reducing tracking to balance the challenge.
– Jōnin's bombs can now be deflected, making encounters more interactive and skill-based.

2.4 Visual Enhancements
– We’ve polished key visuals for a more immersive experience:
– Seoul Angel (Boss) now sports refined textures that heighten the impact of every encounter.
– The portrait for the Mechanic has been completely redone, delivering richer detail and visual appeal.

3 Bug Fixes
3.1 Stability Improvements;
– We've replaced the underlying packaging method, bolstering stability and preventing long-play GC crashes. Enjoy a smoother gaming experience without interruptions.

3.2 Implant Logic Fixes
– Bugs causing implants to activate when they shouldn’t have are now fully resolved. Rest assured, every implant will perform as intended.

4 Important Notice: Save Data Update
– This overhaul introduces major gameplay changes that aren't compatible with older saves. After much deliberation, we've decided to retire legacy save files. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. As a token of our appreciation, players launching a new game with an old save will receive bonus talent materials and cybernetic experience once you complete the prologue and enter the Clinic—ensuring a smooth transition into the new era.

We're dedicated to continuously improving your experience. Thank you for being a loyal part of the Overrider community. Dive into Version 0.3.0 and discover a more dynamic, engaging adventure. Stay tuned for more updates and exciting content!

— The Overrider Development Team

notes.title: important Update! V 0.2 release!
notes.notes:
V 0.2 Update Changelog

1. Override System Adjustments:
1.1 ELPIS (New override resource Added)
- Players now have 3 units of ELPIS. 
- Consumes 1 units per override. 
- Defeating enemies will restore a partial amount of ELPIS.

1.2 Removed former Implant System
- Only drone implants are retained. 
- Legacy implant system replaced with new Override Implant System.

1.3 (New) Override bonus Duration
- Overriding new bodies refreshes bonus timer

1.4  (New) Override Implants:
1.4.1-Hacker Modules: Permanent effects (upgradeable via Night Hunt). Typically related to ELPIS, Override effects, and methods. 
1.4.2- Implant-Trigger (3 max slots): Activates sequentially during new overrides, Triggers all active Implant-Trigger' effects.
1.4.3- Implant -Bonus: have a continuous effect during the buff duration. Tiered effects based on activation count.

1.5 Boss Override Mechanic:
- Triggers at certain health thresholds
- Grants override benefits without gaining the boss's body
- Prime will trigered only once by defeating.

2. Balance Adjustments
2.1-Core Combat
- Enemy HP growth has been significantly reduced
- Enemy attack growth has slightly increased
- player attack growth has also been significantly reduced
(In short, enemies on higher difficulties are easier to kill, and can be killed more easily by the player. You won’t experience the long battles that previously occurred.)

2.2-"Data" Acquisition Changes
-No longer obtainable from:  
   -Enemy defeats;
   -Overrides
- Only get from:
  - Mini-quest (80% crate value) 
  - Post-combat supply crates 
(Mini quest only give Datas now , pervious mini quest rewards type are removed.)

2.3 Synthetic body EXPs
- [Override] now gain the target's EXP. The experience gained through overriding has also been greatly increased.
- (New!) Defeating enemies will give EXP for both the body you control and the body you defeat.

2.4 Implant System Changes
- Due to the overhaul of the implant system, the external implant development system has been temporarily closed. It will be replaced in future updates.

3. Other Important Adjustments:
3.1-Night Hunt UI
- Optimized path selection mechanisms, The new approach ties the route to the rewards, and difficulty dependent on the rewards.
- Removed non-critical HUD elements  

3.2-Legacy System Removal
- High-difficulty penalties disabled  
- Serum effects deprecated
(These are outdated, will be replaced with something new in future updates.)

3.3 Enemy Spawn
- Enemies now respawn immediately upon the death of previous enemies.( Replacing the old way where enemies would respawn wave by wave.)
- The number of enemies on screen has been reduced.
- The total number of enemies on high difficulty has been decreased.

3.4 Story Revisions
- Full dialogue rewrite (save compatible)  
- New game recommended for story experience
(Based on the new experience acquisition methods, implant upgrades have become less grind-heavy.)

3.5 Boss Battles Redone:
3.5.1- Yokozuna:
- Removed the Bosss defense mechanisms.
-The Sikou only effect full-screen retained for the final phase of Purgatory difficulty. In other phases, it is limited to a circular range.

3.5.2- Ms. E.V.A.
- Increased her time on the ground phase. She will fight on the ground for a while before using her whip to ascend.
- After ascending, she will stay in the air longer, and her falling attack will replaced by phantoms, only landing after some time.

3.5.3- Roxanne:
- In phase II, the Flash Assault will now repeat multiple times in certain directions (horizonta/vertical).
- In Purgatory, during phase I she will not immediately wall up after taking damage but will try to attack once more.

4. Bug Fixes:
4.1-Fixed a bug where music still played in Silent Mode.
4.2-Fixed a bug where text would not display in certain Japanese language settings.

v0.1.03 Update Patch

System:

(Critical Update) Quick Save: Now, if you are interrupted during a Night Hunt for any reason, a temporary save will be created. The next time you enter the Night Hunt, you will be asked if you want to continue from the former Hunt progress. If you choose yes, you'll continue with returning to the start of the Large Area where you stopped(the last shop scene from the previous Large Area), to prevent progress loss due to unexpected interruptions.

Gameplay Experience:

The main character, Mayoi, now gains a small amount of experience when defeating enemies, in addition to overriding other Synthic body.

notes.title: OVERRIDER will officially release its early access version on November 29th!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899992/11d67d8d73c63728213ca1b84b651b3d881e4b59.jpg
Thanks to all the action game lovers for your support! OVERRIDER will officially release its early access version on November 29th!

After testing during the June Steam Next Fest and collecting feedback from everyone, we’ve spent this time optimizing the game overall!

Trust us! What we are about to show you is a completely new game!

Although some assets may appear to be familiar, everything from the storyline, game development, combat experience, to the boss battles has undergone a major overhaul!

So, even if you've already played the demo, don't worry about repetition. You will experience a completely fresh and new gameplay experience!
